title: BASS-II summary report: fabric, Nomex and extinction-speed tables
investigation: PSI-25 (BASS-II), with four BASS (PSI-26) rows in Table 7.1
method: Transcribed by Claude Code from the report's text layer as NTRS serves it (TM-20210011385.pdf.txt). Printed pages come from the report's page markers and table of contents. Comments and notes are copied word for word; a '-----' comment becomes a blank.
verification: Claude Code checked every row against the PDF page images (printed pp. 28, 96 and 105) on 2026-09-24. A second-person check is still pending. The Nomex O2 values also match NASA's PSI-25 experimental table.

data/bass-fabric.csv.location: Table 7.1, printed p. 96: test summary of flat SIBAL fabrics in concurrent flow (BASS and BASS-II)
notes: SIBAL (Solid Inflammability Boundary at Low Speeds) is the report's 'cotton-fiberglass fabric blend'.
The flow ran with the flame (concurrent), unlike the opposed-flow acrylic sheets of Table 5.1.
'10 to 5' means the flow started at 10 cm/s and ended at 5 cm/s. The report says the rate of change varied from test to test.
Footnote b, on tests GMT45-T1 and T2: 'O2 reading in these two tests might be inaccurate.'
The report says reused samples 'provided less quantitative data, thus will not be discussed', so the loader leaves them out of verdicts.

A blank comment, or 'BASS', is read as a sample that ignited and burned with no event noted. The report's text counts 'six quenching tests, three nonignited tests, and one blowoff test' among the 27 BASS-II tests.

data/bass-nomex.csv.location: Section 3.1.1, printed p. 46 ('The three Nomex samples did not ignite'), and Table A.2, Ferkul test matrix, printed p. 105
notes: The notes column is Table A.2's comment for each test, word for word.

O2 values are the calibrated initial and final O2 from NASA's PSI-25 experimental table, which match Table A.2. For F3, Table A.2 prints a calibrated final O2 of 0.9, but its own note says 'no postburn sensor readings taken' and PSI-25 leaves the cell empty, so it stays missing.
Table A.2 prints the flow configuration ('Concurrent') under a column headed 'Sample distance'.
Fan and air values are instrument display readings. The report gives no airflow velocity for these tests, so they are never used as cm/s.

data/bass-extinction.csv.location: Table 2.1, printed p. 28: comparison of extinction velocity Vg,cr for thin PMMA at 1 atm
notes: The values are opposed-flow velocities in mm/s. The experimental values carry the report's ± uncertainty.
The report adds that 'the extinction velocity is not a function of fuel thickness'.

limitations: All rows come from one report and are not independent studies.
Neither Table 7.1 nor Table A.2 gives sample thickness, and neither gives measurement uncertainty.
